name: qa-automation-mobile-appium
description: Cross-platform Appium framework with deterministic capability policy, session lifecycle control, failure evidence, and explicit real-device execution boundaries.

scripts.test:framework: npm run build && mkdir -p reports && node --test --test-reporter=tap dist/tests/framework/*.test.js > reports/framework.tap
scripts.test: npm run test:framework && npm run test:evidence:check
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run docs:check && npm run workflow-pins:check && npm run test
